description: Scouting Heritage explores the history of Scouting: the people who started it, key places and events, Scouting memorabilia and museums, the history of your own unit or council, old-time games, and interviewing former Scouts.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words. Requirement 5 was not clearly visible in the excerpts and is not outlined yet.
